description: This file defines a PHP trait called DatabaseTransactions within the SuiteCRM namespace. The trait includes methods for starting and rolling back database transactions using a database manager factory.

methods.name: startDBTransaction
methods.description: Starts a database transaction by executing the 'START TRANSACTION' SQL command through the database manager.

methods.name: rollbackDBTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back a database transaction by executing the 'ROLLBACK' SQL command through the database manager.
